versions.summary: Baseline at the start of the schema registry (FB-151). Before it, 0.1.0 was edited in place several times, most recently to require time_governance (FB-090); those states are in the repository's history and are not versions. At the baseline every schema took the one id form forge://fxts/<framework>/v<version> and gained integrity.schema_version and integrity.schema_hash.
FB-226: one description names the schema-ref module by its new package, forge_core.schema_ref; nothing a spec is checked against changed
